title: Failed Logon Review
description: Review failed logon attempts for a user or endpoint within a time window

title: Account Lockout Investigation
description: Identify source of account lockouts for a specific user

title: Auth Story — User from Specific IP
description: Full auth history for a user and source IP — confirms presence, pivots on outcome

title: Auth Story — IP List
description: All auth events from a list of suspicious IPs — use for IOC-based user pivoting

title: Auth Story — User Failure Triage
description: Failed auth attempts for a specific user — use for brute force or credential stuffing investigation

title: Unusual Outbound Connections
description: Identify endpoints making outbound connections to rare or external destinations

title: Network Story — Outbound to IP
description: All network events to a specific remote IP — use for C2, exfil, or lateral movement investigation

title: Network Story — Outbound to IP List
description: Network activity to any of a list of suspicious remote IPs — use for bulk IOC sweeps

title: Process Tree Review
description: Build process ancestry chain for a suspicious process on a specific device

title: Suspicious PowerShell EncodedCommand Activity
description: Identify PowerShell processes launched with encoded command flags (-enc/-encodedcommand), deduplicated by command line
